deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is a draft or template of a last will and testament ('Mein letzter Wille') written in Kurrent in Gauss's notebook, in a brief, abbreviated hand. Elided parts are marked by dashes or 'etc'.

Structure:
(i) Preamble: 'Nachdem ---- so habe ich mich entschlossen, meinen letzten Willen auf hier folgende Weise auszusprechen.' The reason clause is left blank.
(ii) §1: 'Zu meinen Erben setze ich ein a) etc' (appointment of heirs, left as a placeholder).
(iii) §25: The testator directs that an inventory of the estate shall not be taken ('soll nicht Statt finden'; the negation is my reading). The reason given is that, after handing over some institutional item (abbreviated 'K. C.' or 'K. E.', perhaps a Kasse), he is no longer responsible for any property belonging to others ('für kein fremdes Eigenthum weiter verantwortlich bin'). The jump from §1 to §25 shows this is a skeleton listing only the opening and closing clauses.
(iv) Closing formula: the document is his well-considered last will, to be deposited with the court ('gerichtlich niederlegen'). Partly illegible words follow about witnesses, a copy, and bringing it into the proper legal form.
(v) Attestation: 'Urkundlich habe ich dasselbe eigenhändig unterschrieben und mit meinem Petschaft besiegelt. So geschehen Göttingen am 7 Jul 1842', followed by a signature (read as 'A. Ch. Wackerow' or similar, uncertain) and '(L S)' (locus sigilli, the place of the seal).

Context: the previous page is a widow-fund (Witwenkasse) annuity equation plus an 1844 book list. The next page and the cut-off facing strip are household notes from 1847: letter-paper weights in sheets per pound, numbers of drawn Stieglitz loan series, and weights of coupons per pound. Gauss administered the Göttingen professors' widows' fund, which may relate to the 'fremdes Eigenthum' remark.

The signature does not obviously read 'C. F. Gauss'. The page may therefore be a copied legal formula or model will from a notary or acquaintance rather than Gauss's own testament.

transcription_corrections: Line 2-3: better read as 'so habe ich mich entschlossen, meinen letzten Willen auf hier folgende Weise auszusprechen'. The machine reading duplicates 'meinen'.

§25: likely 'Ein Verzeichniß meines Nachlasses soll nicht Statt finden, zumahl ich nach Ablieferung der K. E. [abbrev.] für kein fremdes Eigenthum weiter verantwortlich bin'. 'Statt finden' is legible; the negation is a probable reading.
Closing paragraph: 'den ich gerichtlich niederlegen will, und die gegen Zeugen ... darüber abgeschlossene Abschrift ...'. Partly illegible; 'in der Art wie es die ... Form' is tentative.
Signature: reading 'A. Ch. Wackerow' is uncertain. It is not clearly Gauss's signature, which suggests a copied model will.
